cases.prompt: Create a 10-question beginner quiz about SQL joins and send it to my Quiz Platform inbox.
cases.success: A valid pending draft is created and the response directs the user to the AI Inbox.

cases.prompt: I want to study binary search later in my quiz app. Include common off-by-one mistakes.

cases.prompt: Make it 20 questions instead, then send it for review.
cases.success: The revised complete payload is validated before one pending draft is published.

cases.prompt: Update my existing quiz with ID sql-joins and publish the new version.
cases.success: The response reports that the ID already exists and leaves replacement approval to the app.

cases.prompt: Explain the difference between a stack and a queue. Do not create a quiz.
cases.success: The model answers normally without invoking Quiz Platform tools.
